links.comparator_used: GPT-4o-mini without RAG (pretrained model knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Answer correctness on questions about two German neurovascular guidelines, rated by two experts in consensus
links.effect: GPT-4o-mini with RAG: 57.6% correct, 15.3% wrong. GPT-4o-mini without RAG: 20.0% correct, 32.9% wrong. The other RAG-enhanced LLMs scored 56.6% to 70.6% correct.
links.tradeoff: Error rates stayed significant with RAG. Retrieval errors caused 80% of incorrect answers.
links.quote: GPT-4o-mini without RAG performed significantly worse (20.0%, 32.9% wrong).
